description: Makes a payment request: a link (https://mercatura.network/r/{id}) that asks for amount USDG (0.01 to 10,000) to `to`, open for days (1 to 30), with a memo of up to 140 characters of plain text. A person pays it with a passkey account or a browser wallet; an agent pays /r/{id}/pay as an ordinary x402 resource. Without signature, the answer is the exact text to sign and a fresh nonce: sign it (EIP-191, personal_sign) with `to` itself, its pay account's owner, one of its unexpired spender keys, or the agent key of one of its rules keys, then call again with nonce, signer and signature. At most 30 requests a UTC day per signer.

amount.description: USDG as a decimal string, like "12.50": signed exactly as sent.

memo.description: Optional: what it is for, one line of plain text.

nonce.description: With signature: the nonce in the signed text (32 bytes; it works once per signer).

rules.description: Optional, when the signer is a rules key's agent: that rules contract's address (not signed; the API's rulesKey). One linked minutes ago is then checked on chain before Mercatura's index has read it.

signature.description: The EIP-191 signature over the text this tool answered without one.

signer.description: With signature: the address that signed.

to.description: Where the money goes: a wallet or a pay account.

name: request_create
title: Payment requests: ask for money
